evidence.title: Evidence type
evidence.description: ABRA Flexi evidence path to extract

load_type.title: Load type
load_type.description: How this evidence is loaded on every run.

options.tooltip:
**Incremental load** (default) — fetches only records whose `lastUpdate` is newer than the last successful run. The component stores a `last_run` watermark in `state.json` and upserts records on the primary key `id`. Use *Date from* only on the very first run as a seed lower bound; after that the watermark takes over and *Date from* is ignored.

**Full load** — ignores the watermark entirely, uses the manual *Date from / Date to* window on every run, and **overwrites** the output table. Use this when you need a fixed historical slice or want to rebuild the table from scratch on each run.

date_from.title: Date from (lastUpdate)
date_from.description: Lower bound of the `lastUpdate` window. Relative ('5 days ago') or absolute ('2026-01-01'). Empty = from the beginning.

options.tooltip:
**Incremental load:** seed lower bound used on the *first* run only (before any watermark exists). Once a `last_run` watermark is stored in state, this field is ignored and the watermark takes over.

**Full load:** lower bound of the `lastUpdate` window applied on every run.

date_to.title: Date to (lastUpdate)
date_to.description: Full load only — upper bound of the `lastUpdate` window. Relative or absolute. Empty = now.

options.tooltip: Incremental load always fetches up to *now* and ignores this field.

detail.title: Detail level
detail.description: How many fields each record includes.

options.tooltip:
**Full** returns the complete record (all fields).

**Summary** returns only the core identifying fields (e.g. id, code, name) — smaller and faster.

**Custom** returns only the fields you list below.

custom_fields.title: Custom fields
custom_fields.description: Comma-separated field list (used when Detail level = custom)

custom_filter.title: Advanced WQL filter
custom_filter.description: Optional raw ABRA Flexi WQL, AND-ed into the Date from/to window.

options.tooltip:
Raw **WQL** expression, written the way it appears inside the URL parentheses: `field operator 'value'`. It is combined with the Date from/to window using `and`.

**Operators:** `eq`, `ne`, `gt`, `lt`, `like`, `is null`, `is empty`. Use `gt`/`lt` for ranges — the API rejects `ge`/`le`. Quote values with single quotes and use full ISO timestamps for dates.

**Examples:**
- `kod eq 'CODE-001'`
- `lastUpdate gt '2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00'`
- `kod eq 'A' and castka gt 1000`

Leave empty to fetch everything within the date window.

Number of records fetched **per API request** (pagination page size). The extractor automatically pages through *all* matching records — this only controls how many are pulled per HTTP call. Higher values mean fewer requests but larger responses. Default `200`.
